name: Miyabi
source:
Yoko=Kitsune - Fox Demon

Weakness: Loves Inari sushi

"Quiet! Let me protect you."

Miyabi can be arrogant, but despite his air of superiority, he would risk his life for you.

"Your soul, your body, your blood...I'll love it all"

Chikage: "Miyabi's needier than he looks. It must be tough hanging out with him every day."
Shinra: "Chikage's right! Plus, he's hard-headed and possessive. Typical Kitsune!"
